content: Data was reassigned, but some private rooms stayed with this account: nobody who could take them has an encryption key. A Full admin who is a member of such a room can change its owner.

comment.text: Warning toast in the data reassignment dialog of the accounts list, shown to an administrator when moving a user's data to another user has finished but some private (end-to-end encrypted) rooms could not be handed over and still belong to the source account. Second sentence says who can fix it: a Full admin (the top portal role, use the language's fixed term for it) who is a member of the room changes its owner. Encryption key is the personal key a user creates to work with private rooms.
